activation_baseline.basis: Neris Solane v677-v3 immutable repository seal at the exact source; Vesper startup failures are retained separately below.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined guidance, roster, and authorization projection exceeded its presentation budget and earned no complete-read credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded file-specific windows completed every required guidance and schema through EOF without mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first raw activation-packet projection exceeded its output budget and was incomplete.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded line windows completed the exact committed activation packet through EOF and verified its normalized-LF digest.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A source-fetch wrapper returned no attributable fetch result and earned zero fresh-live-equality credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A fresh literal ref fetch followed by scalar local, upstream, tracking, and live-remote comparisons established exact equality.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first per-blob manifest validator crossed its command-yield boundary and left one owner-started read-only probe running.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Persisted process state was inspected, the bounded probe was allowed to finish, and no mutation or canonical credit was claimed.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A stop request raced with an already-exited owner-started probe and returned a missing-process error.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The process table and Git state confirmed that the read-only probe had already exited and changed no repository byte.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A second per-blob validator crossed its command-yield boundary and earned zero manifest credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact owner-started probe was identified and stopped, then a single Git batch-object replay completed the immutable comparisons.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A naive byte-count interpretation treated twenty CRLF-projected YAML checkout files as digest mismatches.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The predecessor contract was reread and all normalized-LF Git-blob digests matched; raw checkout-byte differences retained zero failure-conversion credit.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The worktree-creation wrapper yielded before the sparse checkout finished and returned no completion credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The existing registration and checkout were inspected in place after completion; the fresh named lane was clean at the exact source.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first sparse-checkout extension used an unsupported add subcommand option and changed no pattern.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The supported literal add form extended only the declared Vesper x1 manifest path.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first patch-helper invocation was rooted at the app workspace and created three untracked Vesper-named files outside the D-first lane.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only those three newly created files were removed with the patch helper; a verified junction then routed patch edits to the intended Vesper worktree.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first source-bounded semantic audit rejected three exact inherited titles and ten additional titles at or above the preregistered 0.75 token-Jaccard ceiling, then stopped before writing x1 documents.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the thirteen cited Vesper titles were rewritten with narrower microfilm-specific semantics; every unflagged proposal and the immutable source remained unchanged before the isolated audit retry.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first exact staged diff-hygiene check rejected one extra blank line at the x1 builder EOF.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only the extra EOF blank line was removed; the affected manifests and diff-hygiene dependency were regenerated without replaying the successful x1 test invocation.
